milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task — the player must navigate to and visually identify the trapped chest hidden inside the oak planks building at spawn-relative (7, 1, 11). The trapped chest has a subtle red-tinted latch distinguishing it from the regular chest distractor in another building. A max_distance of 5 ensures the player has entered the correct building and is close enough to see the trapped chest. A facing_tolerance of 60 degrees ensures the player is actually looking toward it, confirming visual discovery rather than just passing nearby.
